notes.title: Update Log (October 14)
notes.notes:
1. Shortened the description of Spread Meme to avoid the text exceeding the box
2. The side effect of Rocket Launch was changed to a fixed deduction of 100 HP
3. The SP cost of Forgery Lactea Ray Burst was lowered and its Potency was increased
4. Fixed a bug that Caprae Slashes did not play the skill animation
5. New AI applied when challenging Mr. Lui (The total number of NPC battle victories must be more than 8)
6. Extended the duration of Outstanding Status gained from Tactical Formation: Platinum
7. Fixed a bug that player could view CG in the villa before completing the main storyline
8. Fixed a bug that the Stats of the enemies in the concert hall will be doubled in Hell Mode
9. Increased the absorption of Celestial Storm, but reduced its duration

notes.title: Update Log (October 4)
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an untranslated picture in English version
2. Fixed a bug that the Ctrl dialogue acceleration function still works when opening the menu, shop, or mould interface
3. Slightly modified the background video of the final battle
4. Fixed the error in judging the usage conditions of Fortune Abacus
5. Increased the Stagger amount and cost of Torrentus Break
6. Fixed a bug that empty data would appear when using Jupiter

notes.title: Update Log (October 3)
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the icon error of Carbon Steel Status
2. Modified AI in the final battle. When the opponent has Rebirth Status, the priority of using Sacred Bell for Instants is increased
3. Increased the Potency of Bonefall: No Return
4. Fixed a bug in the judgment of Swarming Fog
5. The unlocking time of the dialogue functions has been advanced
6. Fixed the price display error of the Gachapon machines in the English version
7. Fixed an issue where pressing Ctrl while copying a save code would cause the game to speed up
8. Speeding up dialogues is now allowed in more situations
9. Fixed the display error of enemy Stats when opponents are not tagged in battle
10. Modified the effect of Steel Gauntlet

notes.title: Update Log (September 30)
notes.notes:
The overall Stagger tactic has been buffed:
Falter time changed to 8 seconds, 12 seconds when equipped with The Forge
Modified the special effect of Breakthrough Rampage
Abundant Growth: Nature's Oath and Torrential Tide will inflict Dazed now

1. Fixed a bug that caused UI corruption when using certain status items
2. Single-Target Special Status will no longer fail if the Status count is full
3. Fixed a minor logic error in Goldreamgon Quest that caused the dialogue to appear repeatedly
4. When the main menu has a secondary menu, the icon prompt for using the mouse will no longer pop up, so as to avoid popping up when taking screenshots
5. Debugdbb will no longer be defeated when having Get Rekt Status, to avoid errors when recording damage or SP cost
6. After clearing the game, you can take the elevator directly to the top of the TV tower
7. Removed the usage restriction of Abyssal Sonata, and increased its cost
8. Increased the potency and cost of Vortex Forcefield: Feather Gleam
9. Reduced the cost of Sixwings' skills and modified the special effect of Blessing Overflow
10. Mind Maze will also be available on the Deutsch Engineering black market, and increased its price
11. Fixed a bug that the win/loss judgment in the Concert Hall was incorrect in some cases
12. Fixed the incorrect Trinket type of The Forge
13. Fixed a bug that you couldn't continue the Lucid Dream quest if you didn't get the elevator card
14. Removed the Add to Wishlist button from the full version
15. After completing the story mode, you can review the CG in The Villa
16. Treasures in Important Items can now be sold on the Black Market
17. Some text fixed

notes.title: Update Log (September 22)
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug that the Codex was not working properly in the tutorial map in Arcade mode
2. Reduced the potency and cost of Tomb Seal, and modified the special effect of Nether Hex
3. The 4 default teams in Arcade mode are now determined by the initially selected team
4. Fixed a bug that Andes' pact condition did not appear in Arcade Mode
5. Fixed a bug that pressing M and H would open the map and help when they were disabled
6. You can now retreat in D. S. Salon battles, but it's considered as admitting defeat
7. The new and completed quest animation can now be accelerated by pressing any key
8. You can now skip dialogues by long-pressing the Ctrl key
9. You can now choose an option at Coastline Stadium to attend D. S. Salon

notes.title: Update Log (September 21)
notes.notes:
1. Reduced the SP cost of Particle Wind, and Eternal Information Brand is only usable when CP is higher than 125% now
2. Fixed a bug that NPC support was still effective in the concert hall
3. Fixed an issue that the clock in the Cocoon within The Bund would get stuck when player doesn't have Shineproto in Arcade Mode
4. The Eternile quest in Arcade Mode now requires a pact with Andes as a prerequisite
5. Fixed some text errors
6. Now the description tooltip will be displayed above the left Tab information button
7. Fixed the display error of Darkmoon in Arcade Mode
8. Reduced The cost of Dazzlecorse's Tomb Seal, and increased the Stagger amount and SP cost of Golden Crescent.
9. Added an orange cursor to the title screen
10. You can now return to the title by pressing Esc in the first few sentences of the prologue. And the main menu in prologue can be opened now.

notes.title: Update Log September 17th
notes.notes:
There's a current issue causing the mouse touch area to act up unexpectedly, and we're not sure why. If you come across this bug, you can fix it by using the keyboard, saving and loading the file, or simply restart the game.

Update Log:
1. When the player has a local save file, clicking "Start" on the title screen will pop up a secondary menu for confirmation to prevent accidental clicks
2. Items with small icons in the main menu Items interface can now be dragged and sorted
3. The battle result scene can now be accelerated with a click
4. Fixed some minor issues such as incorrect values, coordinates, unclear statement, and typos
5. Added tips on avoiding fighting Obstructer and Hindrancer
6. Fixed a bug that would cause the game to loop when the Rebirth state is triggered by DS(F) without a talent
7. The approximate location of Trinkets is now shown in advance

The above is an update based on the bugs found on September 16 and the feedback we received. Due to the game code structure, some optimizations are easy and some are difficult. We'll do our best to fix them during the game's first release!

notes.title: Dragon Spirits 2 Prologue Version Updated & Participated in Anime Game Fest!
notes.notes:
The prologue version now has some fresh features and fixed some bugs based on player feedback. These features are not stable yet, if you find any bugs, please contact me.

1. Added text color to Terms in Pact/Cleansing Conditions
2. Optimized the visual effects layering during battle
3. The camera position can now be moved during battle
4. Added VSync and Max Framerate to Options
5. Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze in Elite D.S. Salon
6. Fixed a bug that the dialog function buttons can still be clicked when the dialog box is hidden
7. Reduced the SP cost of Purificatio
8. Lowered the initial level of opponent Dragon Spirits in Stadium Brawl
9. Adjusted some text and textures
10. When selecting a Cognitive Mould to equip, the right mouse button no longer directly closes the page, but returns to the previous menu
11. Added a function of pressing shift+QWER during battle to view skill descriptions
12. Now you can quickly switch between four Dragon Spirits teams
13. The lower half of the Dragon Menu - "All" tab can now be closed
14. Fixed a bug that the Skip feature would cause the Main Menu to open even after being disabled
15. Fixed a bug that Rider Belt doesn't work when Tintling's skills cause its Type to change
16. The CP gained during Lightning Combo Status is reduced from 50% to 25%, and the duration is extended; Thunderous Dash gains an additional 100% CP
17. Removed the restrictions on the use of Eternal Information Brand
18. Changed the background video of Times Avenue
19. Reduced the brightness of some background videos in Cocoons

notes.title: "DragonSpirits2" demo version update (vol0.4)
notes.notes:
In order to celebrate the release of the previous work "Dragon Spirits" , which will be released at the end of the month, a small update is added to this work.

There is no mainline opening for this update, but the game developers have been working on new content for "DragonSpirits 2"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42520654/e223b1d24703a54540fee19c3a440b87e09e8c3a.jpg

update content
1. Fixed the bug of repeatedly obtaining Dragon Soul and Protection through extremely fast operations
2. Fixed the bug of swiping money in the store through negative numbers
3. Added a site: Pu'an Stadium, which contains detailed teaching about the combat system
4. Startup loading is optimized for asynchronous loading
5. Fixed the bug that after saving and reloading the file after choosing Wei Yang's agree/deny option in Waiputan, the bug would freeze
6. The function of exporting and importing archives has been added. Multi-terminal archives can be inherited through the archive code, but do not post the archive code on the public screen in the group. If it is too long, the screen will be swiped
7. The UI of Dragon Soul Formation, Subway Station, Cocoon Room, etc. has been optimized in detail

Known issues
1. Due to the update of some in-game plug-ins, there are some music and detail defects in the dialogue performance, which will be fixed later
2. The compatibility may be changed due to the update of the plug-in.
